flagged.title: Chapters 7-8: Terror & Purges
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims that Minimus's replacement anthem in Chapter 7 praises the leader/Napoleon, conflating it with the Chapter 8 poem 'Comrade Napoleon' and teaching a factual error that would cause students to fail knowledge checks and recall questions.

mark_affecting.quote: Minimus's Anthem, praising the leader / Minimus's anthem on the other hand is purely about praising Animal Farm and its leader.
